lamp-low: The lamp takes a moment to steady itself, the way a tired man does. There is less oil in it than there was.
lamp-dead: The lamp burns down to a red bead, considers the matter, and goes out. The dark moves in like it owns the place, which by now it does.
dark-warning: It is pitch dark. If you keep walking you will be navigating on faith, in a place with no record of rewarding it.
dark-death: You put a foot out into the dark, and the dark — which has had ninety years of practice at exactly this — accepts it. There is a moment where the floor should be, and then there are no more moments.
no-hints: Nothing useful comes to mind. Either you have not found the problem yet, or you have already solved it and are refusing to take credit.
stalker-death: The lamp gets one full look at it, which is one more than anyone before you was given. The last thing you understand is that the gait was never patience. It was certainty.
thief-robbery: A sound like drag-marks being made at speed, a breath of musty air, and your pockets are lighter by everything that glittered. Somewhere down the dark, an acquisition is already being filed under shine.
roof-fall-death: The mountain, relieved of its timber, sits down where you are standing. It has been wanting to for ninety years, and it does not do things by halves.
gour-flood-death: The water comes back over the lip all at once, the way an argument ends. The pools have you now, and the pools are patient. Pearls are grown a layer at a time, around things that stayed.
chute-death: You commit yourself to the chute, which is what the chute has been waiting for. It takes you the fast way down, in the manner it took ore — which is to say, in no condition to be sorted on arrival.
swim-death: You strike out for the middle. Halfway across, the thing the fish have always known about the channel becomes, briefly, something you know too. The river closes over the discussion.
jump-death: [draft] The gap was cut for longer legs, and it knew that before you jumped.
keg-death: The powder does not wait to hear your reasoning. NOT WITHOUT A FUSE, DAVEY, said the keg — and Davey, at least, is on record as having been told.
